source: Every frame is built from exactly TWO of the author's renders — 00_rest and 05_ALL — which sit within 1.2px of each other. Each state takes the glow of one more tile from the all-lit frame and lays it on the rest frame. Nothing is warped and nothing is masked out, so the floor, both hands and every unlit tile are the SAME PIXELS in every frame and cannot drift. Her other four renders are not used: they differ by camera distance AND re-posed hands AND lighting, and no alignment can reconcile that. The cost is that the finger does not travel to each tile.
